description:
### Bou 1.4.0

* Banglish to Bengali script for Rambler voice typing, English words stay English
* Regional speech: Chittagong, Sylhet, Barisal and common Dhaka forms
* Optional AI mode with your own free Gemini key
* In-app updates from Bou's GitHub releases

Supports Gboard 18.6.3.100 (arm64).
